text: Compile C/C++ programs with clang/clang++ into WebAssembly (with WASI) and run them in the app
quote: For C and C++, you compile your programs with `clang program.c` and it produces a webAssembly file. You can then execute it with either `wasm a.out` or `a.out`.

text: Install additional pure-Python packages with pip install
quote: For Python, you can install more packages with `pip install packagename`, but only if they are pure Python.

text: Vim is included for editing files, with syntax checkers available via vim-lsp or ALE
quote: a-Shell comes with Vim included. You can edit your files and even run syntax checkers using e.g. vim-lsp or ALE.

text: Open multiple windows, each with its own context, appearance, command history and current directory
quote: Each window has its own context, appearance, command history and current directory. `newWindow` opens a new window, `exit` closes the current window.

text: Customize the terminal's font, font size, background, text color, and cursor color and shape via config
quote: You can change the appearance of a-Shell using `config`. It lets you change the font, the font size, the background color, the text color and the cursor color and shape.

text: Make the current window's appearance settings permanent for all future windows with config -p
quote: config -p will make the settings for the current window permanent, that is used for all future windows.

text: Configure the toolbar with config -t
quote: With `config -t` you can also configure the toolbar.

text: Select color themes like dracula, with an option to apply them to all open windows and save them in Settings
quote: Select a theme with `config --theme dracula`. Add `-g` to update every open window and save the theme in Settings

text: Define custom color themes by editing a JSON file in the Windows Terminal color scheme format
quote: Edit the JSON file in Files or a text editor. It uses the Windows Terminal color scheme format

text: Install custom .ttf/.otf fonts in ~/Documents/Fonts and register them with config --fonts
quote: For font files, create `~/Documents/Fonts` and drop `.ttf` or `.otf` files there using Files. Run `config --fonts` to register them and list available face names.

text: Choose fonts through a font picker or by PostScript name
quote: `config -n picker` opens the font picker without a monospace-trait filter... Installed fonts can also be selected by PostScript name with `config -n "face name"`.

text: Bookmark directories and jump to them with bookmark, showmarks, jump, and cd ~mark
quote: You can also bookmark the current directory with `bookmark`. `showmarks` will list all the existing bookmarks, `jump mark` and `cd ~mark` will change the current directory to this specific bookmark.

text: Works with Apple Shortcuts, so complex Shortcuts can download, process and release files using shell commands
quote: a-Shell is compatible with Apple Shortcuts, giving users full control of the Shell. You can write complex Shortcuts to download, process and release files using a-Shell commands.

text: Shortcuts action 'Execute Command' runs a list of commands in order, taking input from text or a file
quote: `Execute Command`, which takes a list of commands and executes them in order. The input can also be a file or a text node

text: Shortcuts actions 'Put File' and 'Get File' transfer files into and out of a-Shell
quote: `Put File` and `Get File` are used to transfer files to and from a-Shell.

text: Force a shortcut to run either in the app or in the extension
quote: You can force a specific shortcut to run "in App" or "in Extension", with the warning that it won't always work.

text: Access directories in other apps' sandboxes with pickFolder and work on the files there
quote: Type `pickFolder` to access a directory inside another App. Once you have selected a directory, you can do pretty much anything you want here

text: Directories opened with pickFolder are bookmarked automatically so you can return to them later
quote: All the directories you access with `pickFolder` are bookmarked, so you can return to them later without `pickFolder`.

text: Run TeX or Python in other apps' folders and send the results to a third app
quote: a-Shell uses iOS file sharing ability. You can open directories in other app sandbox with pickFolder and run TeX or Python there. You can send the result in a third app.

text: Built-in help lists all available commands and lets you check whether a specific command is installed
quote: `help -l` lists all the available commands. `help -l | grep command` will tell you if your favorite command is already installed.

text: Supports VoiceOver: reads commands as you type, reads results, and lets you explore the screen by touch
quote: a-Shell will work with VoiceOver: reading commands as you type them, reading the result, letting you read the screen with your finger...

text: Ships with multiple programming languages: Python, Lua, JavaScript, C, C++ and TeX
quote: a-Shell has several programming languages installed: Python, Lua, JS, C, C++ and TeX.

text: Install extra precompiled WebAssembly commands such as zip, unzip, xz and ffmpeg with the pkg command
quote: These include `zip`, `unzip`, `xz`, `ffmpeg`... You install them on your iPad using the `pkg` command: `pkg install zip`.

text: Cross-compile programs on a computer with a dedicated WASI-sdk and transfer the WebAssembly file to iPad or iPhone
quote: You can also cross-compile programs on your main computer using our specific WASI-sdk, and transfer the WebAssembly file to your iPad or iPhone.

text: Provides a Unix-like terminal on iOS with commands from the ios_system ecosystem (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex)
quote: It uses ios_system for command interpretation, and includes all commands from the ios_system ecosystem (nslookup, whois, python3, lua, pdflatex, lualatex...)

text: Manage files locally: create directories, move, compress, uncompress and edit files
quote: Create directories, move files, compress them, uncompress them, edit them, run python, lua or Tex on your files, move them to other apps.

text: Runs a .profile file when a new window opens, for custom environment variables or cleanup
quote: When opening a new window, a-Shell executes the file `.profile` if it exists. You can use this mechanism to customize further, e.g. have custom environment variables or cleanup temporary files.

text: TeX distribution can be downloaded on demand when you first run a TeX command
quote: TeX files are not installed by default. Type any TeX command and the system will prompt you to download them.

text: Fully open source, released under the FreeBSD license
quote: a-Shell is entirely OpenSource, and released under the FreeBSD license.
